api.input: Original ArrayBuffer or Uint8Array every call; patched variants rejected.

defaultLayout: Original mesh1 becomes BodySkin. Scalp appended separately. Optional wardrobe omitted; selected garments append separately. Face0/Hair2 indices stable.

restFit.rule: Map original world heads with F. Update local translations by child-parent world deltas. Subtract joint world delta from every inverse-bind translation. Load patched GLB before three-vrm rest caches initialize.

colliders: VRM0 local z is negated vs glTF. Map original world center; subtract fitted joint world. Keep radii unchanged; approximate sphere fit.
reset: Zero controls preserve source vertex/normal/bind bytes. Additionally layout=original returns full byte-identical source.
verified: Deterministic repeat; SHA guard; immutable source
gate: Blender authoring pose/blink/reset passed separately. Live app three-vrm load, pose, spring, slider and reset validation still required.
